content.short: Kyber Network is a multi-chain liquidity hub aggregating DEX liquidity for users and dapps.
content.description: Kyber Network aggregates liquidity from multiple DEX protocols and its own pools so users and integrating applications get a single point of access. Swaps price against that combined depth, and liquidity providers earn swap fees plus farming rewards on capital-efficient positions. KNC holders stake to vote on governance and receive a share of trading fees. Any application can integrate the same instant exchange through its developer tooling, and it now appears in the Hyperliquid ecosystem alongside its established deployments.
content.meta: Aggregated DEX liquidity for users and integrating applications, now including Hyperliquid.
